guest.notes: requires apple hardware for a legitimate guest; bespoke machine definition with smc

disclaimer: apple's software licence restricts virtualising macos guests to apple hardware. we keep the toolchain, the manifest and the bridges because the work is real and useful on apple hardware; complying with apple's terms when you use it is the user's responsibility, not something this project enforces or pretends away
constraints: apple's licence restricts macos guests to apple hardware: the disclaimer field carries the terms, not a refusal
no metal: gpu-accelerated apps refuse to run and software rendering is the only fallback
needs ovmf plus smc emulation and apple boot quirks, so the machine definition is bespoke, not a stock q35
icloud and licence activation may flag a virtual machine: assume local-only apps as the supported workload
last release before catalina dropped 32-bit apps: this is the 32-bit app lane
